Name: Get passkey registration status
Description: Lists which licensed or role-holding users have registered a passkey (FIDO2) as an authentication method, and which have not.

Parameters.Name: Mode
Parameters.Label: Mode
Parameters.HelpText: Live reads each user's passkeys directly. Report uses the registration report (needs Entra ID P1/P2).

Parameters.Name: Show
Parameters.Label: Show
Parameters.HelpText: Which users to return: All, Registered or NotRegistered. Users that could not be checked are always returned.

Parameters.Name: IncludeGuests
Parameters.Label: Include guests
Parameters.HelpText: Include guest (B2B) accounts. By default only member accounts are checked.

Parameters.Name: IncludeDisabled
Parameters.Label: Include disabled
Parameters.HelpText: Include disabled accounts. By default only enabled accounts are checked.
